definition: Metamorphopsia is a distortion of local or spatial perception in which sensations are referred to the wrong place, especially in vision when a displaced but still light-sensitive part of the retina no longer matches the outside world. The term was also applied historically to similar errors of localization in the skin after tissue has been shifted.
